# Agency Weekly Instagram Competitor Report Template

This template is designed for social media agencies, freelance marketers, and client reporting teams.

Use it to turn competitor monitoring data into a client-ready weekly report.

## Delivery Checklist

Before sending to the client:

- [ ] Report period is correct.
- [ ] Competitor list is correct.
- [ ] Links are working.
- [ ] Top posts / Reels are ranked consistently.
- [ ] Recommendations are specific.
- [ ] No private data is included.
- [ ] No unverified partnership claims are made.
- [ ] Report is client-ready.
